title: Neural Geometry as a Learning Signal
abstract: arXiv:2611.26832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate whether the geometric structure of neural representations can provide a sufficient learning signal for improving model behavior without any supervision on model outputs. First, we fine-tune Llama-3.1-8B to answer questions such as "What month is four months after June?" by supervising internal representations of the input month (June = 6) and offset (4), which are encoded with Fourier harmonics. Second, we fine-tune the model to predict line breaks in text wrapped to a fixed width by supervising an internal representation of the number of characters since the preceding newline, which is represented by a low-dimensional helical structure. In both tasks, we supervise a low-dimensional subspace of the residual stream using an idealized target structure, and find that internal geometric supervision achieves similar performance to standard fine-tuning (despite no supervision on outputs). translated_title: 神经几何作为学习信号
translated_abstract: 我们研究神经表示的几何结构能否提供一种足够的学习信号，从而在不监督模型输出的情况下改进模型行为。首先，我们通过监督输入月份（如 June = 6）和偏移量（4）的内部表示来微调 Llama-3.1-8B，使其能够回答诸如“六月之后的四个月是几月？”这类问题，这些内部表示以傅里叶谐波的形式编码。其次，我们微调模型来预测按固定宽度换行的文本中的换行符，方法是监督“自上一个换行符以来的字符数”这一内部表示，该表示由一个低维螺旋结构刻画。在这两个任务中，我们都使用理想化的目标结构来监督残差流的一个低维子空间，结果发现内部几何监督能够达到与标准微调相似的性能（尽管完全没有对模型输出进行监督）。此外，我们发现简单地修补 i……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明只需监督模型内部表示的几何结构（如傅里叶谐波和低维螺旋结构），就能在完全不监督输出的情况下取得与标准微调相当的模型改进效果。
en_tdlr: Supervising only the geometric structure of internal neural representations (e.g., Fourier harmonics and low-dimensional helical structures) achieves performance comparable to standard fine-tuning, without any supervision on model outputs.
